invariants.rationale: The method immediately returns if layers is null; so useful as a safe-guard and is the main precondition for non-trivial work.
tmjFile is used as an argument in getRelativeFileHandle, which likely requires it to be non-null.
fileHandles.add is called in the body, which requires fileHandles to be non-null.
Since layers is iterated in a for-each loop, it is expected to be an array-type JsonValue (and not a primitive or object).
The size of an Array cannot be negative; this captures a basic well-formedness invariant for fileHandles.
